headline: TRITN jumps 50.00% on strong volume, leading a surge in construction stocks.
market_take: Construction stocks dominated today with multiple high‑volume moves, while PF&REITs saw several price‑gap and volume‑spike events. Food sector showed mixed signals as XBIO rallied 12.50% intraday but F&D fell 7.61% on an open gap. Notable corporate actions include asset‑disposal filings from AMATAV/AMATA and a high‑profile connected‑transaction filing from ITC.

sector_notes.note: TRITN surged 50.00% with a 2.54× volume boost and EMC recorded a 41.8σ volume spike, indicating heightened volatility in construction.
JCK rose 8.33% on 1.98× volume and PLAT posted a 4.6σ volume spike plus a 7.46% move; asset‑disposal filings from AMATAV and AMATA may impact valuations.
M‑PAT logged a 4.5σ volume spike and a 6.87% intraday rise, while QHOP and MIPF experienced 100% price gaps, highlighting liquidity pressures.
XBIO climbed 12.50% on modest volume; ITC released earnings and a high‑profile connected‑transaction filing; F&D dropped 7.61% on an open gap.
TFM submitted three Q2 earnings filings, and PPPM added 4.55% on 1.40× volume, suggesting steady interest in agribusiness.
GEL surged 33.33% intraday; DCON and WIIK posted price gaps; SCCC announced a director resignation.
